exclusions: Any source item outside the frozen UTC window

definition_of_done: Every assigned source item was reviewed against its stored source-item record and raw manifest

result.summary: Created 16 atomic draft observations from 13 assigned media source items while preserving media attribution, upstream-lineage limitations, paywall constraints, original-language excerpts, and verification qualifiers.
coverage_gaps: No observation was created from item_20260804_ft_wildberries because the Financial Times article body was paywalled and the frozen repository contained no permitted substantive excerpt or artifact beyond title metadata.

The Guardian briefing and several Reuters and AP reports are derivative of unresolved primary statements or agency material, so their observations preserve media attribution and are not treated as independent corroboration.
The Reuters Kherson video report verified location but not the video's date; both the reaction and the verification limitation were extracted separately.
Direct upstream Turkish, Russian, Ukrainian ministry, regional-authority, company, and social-platform records cited by the media items were not separately resolved in this bounded extraction task.
